title: Quentin and the Orbit
author: Coral Hartwell
blurb: Zephyrine Sterling, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
